mapper.sql:
where u.del_flag = '0' and u.wx_openid is not null and u.wx_openid <> ''
and ( u.nick_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.phone_number like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and u.create_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00')
and u.create_time < date_add(concat(#{endTime}, ' 00:00:00'), interval 1 day)
mapper.select:
select u.user_id as userId, u.nick_name as nickName, u.user_name as userName, u.phone_number as phoneNumber, u.avatar as avatar, u.sex as sex, u.status as status, coalesce(concat_ws('', ua.region, ua.detail), '') as address, coalesce(ua.contact_name, '') as addressContactName, coalesce(ua.contact_phone, '') as addressContactPhone, exists (select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where ur.user_id=u.user_id and r.role_key='mini_admin' and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0') as miniAdmin, date_format(u.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime, 'mini_program' as source from sys_user u left join zjudg_user_address ua on ua.address_id = ( select a.address_id from zjudg_user_address a where a.user_id = u.user_id and a.status = '0' order by a.is_default desc, a.create_time desc limit 1 )
order by u.create_time desc
